title: `DATE_DIFF()` with just two args fails with NPE

labels.name: Team:Analytics
labels.description: Meta label for analytical engine team (ESQL/Aggs/Geo)

body:
### Description

`row date_diff("year", "2021-12-12")` and `row date_diff("2021-12-12", "2022-12-12")` will both NPE.
